Careers at Excel Nearshore

Do you live in Costa Rica and have a technical degree or certification in IT or software development? If so, we encourage you to review the currently open roles below, or contact us today for an immediate interview. Excel is actively looking for candidates to augment IT and development staffs at large corporations in the United States. to perform the following functions:

  • Agile Software Development
  • Mobile App Development
  • Cloud and DevOps Services
  • Software Integration
  • Enterprise App Development
  • IoT Development
  • Platform Services
  • SDET and QA Services
  • UI / UX Design

Excel is also looking to establish a network of Project Managers, Business Analysts and Graphic Designers—so if you fit one of these backgrounds, please feel free to contact us also. We look forward to hearing from you!
